responsibility: Declares the Rust HIR statement type-checking visitor. TypeCheckStmt is the dispatcher that routes statement forms to expression, pattern, type, item, and extern-item checkers and provides the statement-resolution entry point used by block and function-body checking.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TypeCheckStmt statement visitor and its visit hooks for statement and item-like statement forms, without providing the dispatch and coercion logic itself. That behavior lives in rust-hir-type-check-stmt.cc.
